meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 审查已完成改动的把关流程：主代理先在真实界面上亲手做手动 QA，逐项记为通过/失败矩阵；无失败行时，只派一个门控审查子代理，对照目标、约束、质量、安全等做总检查，通过才放行。
howto.when: 完成实现后、把改动作为 PR 交接前，或用户明确要求审查已完成工作时触发。

say.text: 请门控审查这轮改动：先在真实界面上跑手动 QA，再启动一位门控审查官。
say.note: 会先生成 QA 矩阵；只要有失败行就判失败并跳过子代理。

say.text: 我刚完成这个新功能，请做一次门控审查再交接。
say.note: 会收集目标、约束与改动上下文，交给唯一的门控审查子代理。

say.text: 请对这个分支的改动做门控审查，重点看有没有漏掉的上下文。
say.note: 门控审查还会检查代码质量、安全性与需求符合度。

howto.what_en: Reviewing finished work = main agent does manual QA on the real surface and logs pass/fail rows; if no row fails, one gate-reviewer subagent checks goal, constraints, quality, security, missed context, QA evidence; clear only if both pass.
howto.when_en: Triggers after implementation, before handing off a PR, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

say_en.text: Please gate-review this batch: real-surface manual QA first, then one gate reviewer.
say_en.note: QA failure rows abort the review and skip the gate reviewer.

say_en.text: I just finished this new feature; run a gate review before handoff.
say_en.note: Goal, constraints, QA evidence go to that single gate reviewer.

say_en.text: Gate-review this branch's changes, focusing on missed context.
say_en.note: It also checks code quality, security, and goal fit.
